import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

sns.set(style="whitegrid")
plot = sns.catplot(x='class', y='survived', hue='sex', kind='bar', data=df, ci=None, height=6, aspect=1.5)
plot.set_axis_labels("Passenger Class", "Survival Rate")
plot.fig.suptitle("Titanic Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Gender", y=1.01)
plt.tight_layout()

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
